name: mihari (Sentry-compatible error triage)
description: Stdio MCP server for the mihari itonami dapp: groups Sentry envelopes and event JSON into Sentry-shaped issues and applies mihari triage rules. Pure tools over the passed text; sends and stores nothing.
author: cloud-itonami

MIHARI_REPO.description: Absolute path to a cloud-itonami/app-itonami-mihari checkout at the pinned commit. The launcher re-executes with this directory as cwd so kbb resolves the pinned kotoba-lang/text from nbb.edn.
